english_text: I need to know what to bring to my appointment.
sesotho_text: Ke hloka ho tseba se ke se tlisang appointment ea ka.

english_text: Can I bring my medical records to the appointment?
sesotho_text: Na nka tlisa lirekoto tsa ka tsa bongaka appointment?

english_text: I would like to know if I need to fast before my appointment.
sesotho_text: Ke rata ho tseba haeba ke hloka ho ikitima lijo pele ho appointment ea ka.

english_text: I need to know if I should stop my medication before the test.
sesotho_text: Ke hloka ho tseba haeba ke lokela ho emisa moriana oa ka pele ho tlhahlobo.

english_text: Can I eat before my blood test appointment?
sesotho_text: Na nka ja pele ho appointment ea tlhahlobo ea mali?

english_text: I would like to know how to prepare for my appointment.
sesotho_text: Ke rata ho tseba ho itokisetsa joang bakeng sa appointment ea ka.

english_text: I need to know if my appointment will be long.
sesotho_text: Ke hloka ho tseba haeba appointment ea ka e tla nka nako e telele.

english_text: Can I bring my child to my appointment?
sesotho_text: Na nka tlisa ngoana oa ka appointment ea ka?

english_text: I would like to know if there is parking at the clinic.
sesotho_text: Ke rata ho tseba haeba ho na le sebaka sa ho emisa koloi klinikeng.

english_text: I need directions to the clinic for my appointment.
sesotho_text: Ke hloka litaelo tsa ho ea klinikeng bakeng sa appointment ea ka.

english_text: Can I attend my appointment via telephone?
sesotho_text: Na nka tla appointment ea ka ka mohala?

english_text: I would like to know if telehealth appointments are available.
sesotho_text: Ke rata ho tseba haeba li-appointment tsa telehealth li fumaneha.

english_text: I need to reschedule my appointment due to transport problems.
sesotho_text: Ke hloka ho fetola appointment ea ka ka lebaka la mathata a lipalangoa.

english_text: Can I get a home visit instead of coming to the clinic?
sesotho_text: Na nka fumana ketelo ea lapeng ho e-na le ho tla klinikeng?

english_text: I would like to know the cost of my appointment.
sesotho_text: Ke rata ho tseba theko ea appointment ea ka.

english_text: I need to know if my appointment is covered by my medical aid.
sesotho_text: Ke hloka ho tseba haeba appointment ea ka e koaheloa ke medical aid ea ka.

english_text: Can I get a free appointment at this clinic?
sesotho_text: Na nka fumana appointment ea mahala klinikeng ena?

english_text: I would like to know if I need a referral for my appointment.
sesotho_text: Ke rata ho tseba haeba ke hloka referral bakeng sa appointment ea ka.

english_text: I need to bring my referral letter to the appointment.
sesotho_text: Ke hloka ho tlisa lengolo la referral appointment.

english_text: Can I book an appointment without a referral?
sesotho_text: Na nka buka appointment ntle le referral?

english_text: I would like to know if I need an appointment or can walk in.
sesotho_text: Ke rata ho tseba haeba ke hloka appointment kapa nka kena feela.

english_text: I need to know the clinic's appointment hours.
sesotho_text: Ke hloka ho tseba linako tsa li-appointment tsa kliniki.
